name: Fuminari Shuuzou
source:
The protagonist of the Fuminari Arc.
Living under the Futatsuguri family's roof, Shuuzou's a sorcerer whose trade is curse-induced murder. Known for his cynical nature, this middle-aged man prefers to speak and act in a deliberately villainous manner.
Shuuzou still clings to the memory of his mentor, Enju, who passed away during his youth, even after all these years.

"I'm beat, Togetsu. Way I see it, you ain't gonna put my suspicions to rest, so that makes you an enemy."
